column1: # cc-router agent table — one row per foreign agent; a new agent is a new row.
# Tab-separated, ten fields, no header row; lines starting with # are comments.
#   name      agent id, exposed as cc-harness:<name> (and as the claude
#             wrapper's --<name> flag, which lives outside this repo)
#   model     ANTHROPIC_MODEL — the LAST-KNOWN model for a discovering agent
#   fable     ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL — the picker tier above opus. Left
#             unset, picking it sends a claude-fable id to the gateway, out of
#             the routed family, so every row names one.
#   opus      ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL
#   sonnet    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL (the "previous rung" discovery moves)
#   haiku     ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL
#   max_ctx   CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS — ONE number per session, applied
#             to whichever model is active, including after /model. Too low
#             compacts early; too high overflows upstream.
#   cred      credential prefix in the proxy dir (<cred>-*.json)
#   login     cliproxyapi login flag suggested when credentials are missing
#   provider  label for messages
# Every rung a user can reach with /model must hold max_ctx. The codex rows
# hold that; grok (200000 composer under 500000) and kimi (unmeasured
# kimi-k2.7-code) still carry a smaller haiku rung — a known exception, not a
# pattern to copy. ~/.config/cc-router/models.tsv, when present, replaces this
# file.
# Values (verified against the route's catalog and measurements):
#   grok-4.6        500000; the composer haiku rung is only 200k (haiku tier only)
#   kimi-k3         262144 — the Kimi Code plan serves 256k, not the marketed 1M
#   gpt-5.6-*       372000 — the subscription cap
#   gpt-6-astra     900000 measured, but exported as 372000: see the ladder
# CODEX LADDER (astra/sol/terra/luna): one ladder in all four rows — fable =
# Astra, opus = Sol, sonnet = Terra, haiku = Luna — so the rows differ ONLY in
# their primary. Every rung is reachable with /model and the window is
# session-wide, so the ceiling is 372000 for all four, astra included: its own
# 900000 over a Luna rung is one /model away from an upstream overflow that
# auto-compact never prevents. The shared ladder couples availability on
# purpose: a route that stops serving any of the four ids takes all four rows
# down, naming the id, because a row must never publish a rung the route
# cannot serve. New ids enter by a deliberate, probed edit — never because a
# catalog lists them.
grok
kimi
sol
terra
luna
astra
